summary.text: Barbara Bagshaw is a Republican state representative from Maine House District 106, in office since December 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Bradley Youngs.

paragraphs.text: Bagshaw took office on December 6, 2022, succeeding Amanda Collamore, and she serves on the Education and Cultural Affairs Committee.
